messages:
Jules: Quick thread 7 - we need to decide what to prioritize in the coming micro-sprint: the performance regression on embeddings (customer-reported) or a set of small feature polish tasks.
Harper: Regression shows up as ~12% slower p95 for embeddings on large batched requests. Two enterprise customers flagged cost increase.
Ravi: Root cause likely from batching change merged last week. Reverting is ~1 dev-day but we'd lose newer batching gains.
Tess: Polishes are 4 tickets: response formatting, missing tooltips, docs update, and a tiny routing toggle. All are low-effort (2-6hrs each).
Marco: Impact matrix: regression = $$$ risk for paying customers; polishes = net NPS uplift but not urgent.
CS-Liaison: Coming from customers: strong ask to reduce cost impact. They'll accept a short degraded UX window if we fix perf quickly.
Jules: Proposal A: immediate revert of batching change to restore p95 and cut costs. Proposal B: targeted perf hotfix that preserves gains but takes longer.
Harper: Revert ETA: 1 dev-day + canary. Hotfix ETA: 5 dev-days.
Ravi: Can we do a hybrid: revert to stop customer pain, then re-introduce a refined change in next iteration after tests?
Tess: If we revert, can I pick up the 4 polishes and ship them in parallel? They fit into 1 dev-sprint slot together.
Marco: Business says revert is acceptable short-term. Prefers hybrid to not lose long-term improvements.
Jules: Decision: adopt hybrid. Revert to stop immediate regression (owner Ravi), schedule a refined batching rework as a follow-on epic (owner Harper, estimate 10d). Ship polishes in parallel.
Ravi: Opening revert PR branch `revert/batching-heatfix-1729`. Link: https://github.com/redwood/repo/pull/789 (WIP).
ops-bot: Canary window requested: 2024-07-01T03:00Z for service "embed-service". Auto-rollout threshold 0.1% error.
CS-Liaison: I'll notify the two customers that we have mitigated the cost spike and will follow up about the plan to bring back improved batching.
Tess: Polishes assigned: PROD-1201, PROD-1202, PROD-1203, PROD-1204. ETA: 2 days total.
Harper: Logging follow-on epic: `batching-rework-2.0` with acceptance criteria and perf targets.
Jules: Recap: revert now, polishes in current micro-sprint, refined rework next planning cycle. Owners set. Close thread when revert is live in prod. :white_check_mark:
